text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: How did you find that novel...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It was so interesting! There were so many 
thrilling spells and cool witches.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The coolest one is the 'Witch of 
Kashiwagi'! She kinda reminds me of 
Grandma.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! Isn't she a wonderful witch?! The 
overflowing compassion beneath her suave 
demeanor, the way she watches over the 
protagonist from a respectful distance...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And yet, whenever the protagonist is in a 
pinch, they swoop in gallantly and wipe 
out the enemy with overwhelming magic! The 
understated way it's depicted is just so 
good, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! That's what I thought was 
so cool about it!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"The Witch of the Chin" is another top 
recommendation of mine...! Even if 
misunderstood by those around her, her 
core strength never flatters anyone and 
stays true to herself!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A fierce battle against a fated rival 
encountered while following one's own 
path! And then the finishing catchphrase: 
'I'll tear destiny to shreds with my own 
fangs!'

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! S-Sorry, it's just been me 
talking... ......

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey, why are you suddenly quiet?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I love listening to you talk passionately 
about your favorite books, Rob Roy—it's so 
fun! Don't just go quiet on me! That's 
boring!
